notes.title: 🌾 Dev Log – June 8, 2025: Ghosts in the Field
notes.content:
🔧 What’s New
Page Reader Implemented
You can now read notes and letters found in the farmhouse, revealing fragments of the backstory.

Object Inspection Camera Improved
Smoother zoom and positioning makes examining clues more natural and immersive.

Ghost Child Behavior Added
A spectral child plays in the field—until you see him. Then he runs.

Controls Refined
We’ve polished player movement and interaction for better feel.

New Teaser Trailer Released
Our latest teaser is live on YouTube!
👉 Watch the Teaser
[hr][/hr]🔜 Coming Soon
Level states to track narrative progression

Completion of the options menu (volume, language, etc.)

First implementation of musical cues tied to in-game moments



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593586/fc02385e693ecb2c46bc71be545c326cf898dfd2.png"]
[hr][/hr]🎉 Happy Next Fest!
We’re not participating in June’s Next Fest—but we’re excited to see what other indie devs have been building. If you're trying new demos, we’d love to hear what you're playing!
[hr][/hr]
🎮 No One Leaves the Field is building toward its first demo.
If you haven’t yet:

👉 Wishlist it on Steam

Thanks for following our journey through the field.
#JoinTheSaga Happy #NextFest
